subject: gnomeTinkerer
pitch:
Category: Humanoid character.
Subject: gnome tinkerer with a backpack of gadgets.
Style: whimsical low-poly mix.
reasoning:
Looking at the render, the nose is way too large, covering the face like a red muzzle and crowding out the tiny eyes positioned too close to it. I need to shrink the nose and move the eyes farther apart so they're visible and proportioned correctly.

Other fixes: the skull looks oddly brownish from flat shading on the paint function, so switching to a plain skin color string should look cleaner and more consistent. The backpack texture reads as dull dark brown, so lightening it will help it stand out, and the hip pouch, hat, goggles, and arm placement all look fine as is.

The legs are the bigger issue though—pants and boots are both muddy brown that blend together with the blue tunic above, so I want to shift the pants to an olive/mustard tone with darker boots for contrast. Everything else (base terrain, mushrooms, beard, ears, lantern, sign placement) looks acceptable, so I'll keep the edit list minimal and safe, starting with switching the skull material to the plain SKIN color.

Still adjusting facial features... fixing eye position and size, shrinking and repositioning the nose with its highlight, and now changing the pants to olive-green stripes with a darker boot color.

Lightening the pack and flap colors, leaving the eyebrows and mustache as they are, and finalizing the edits to match the existing lines precisely.
